evidence_boundary: External literature is METHOD_INPUT only. It does not establish Qwen3.5-0.8B causal J-Space control, canonical semantics, runtime acceptance or training credit.

external_method_inputs.use: Compact internal directions can causally encode reusable in-context functions in studied models; motivates searching for functional subspaces rather than assuming all semantics are diffuse.
Activation differences can steer high-level behavior in studied models; motivates causal intervention tests but not transfer of vectors across models.
Small models can struggle with semantically unrelated or flipped label mappings; dynamic episode-local codebook binding must therefore be an explicit 0.8B training and evaluation target.
Steering-vector effects can be prompt-dependent and brittle under distribution shift; a single global semantic direction is not an adequate acceptance assumption.
Instruction-specific activation directions and composition motivate function-specific READ/BIND/WRITE control tests rather than one undifferentiated steering axis.

Activation steering can induce broad off-target behavioral changes in studied models including Qwen-3.5-series settings; off-target/misalignment sweeps must be first-class acceptance tests. This does not assert the effect for the exact future Clay 0.8B checkpoint.

core_revision.explanation: A candidate semantic representation may be compact, but it must be indexed and tested by exact model identity, layer/subspace, Hyperposition state/projection, task/function, intervention scope, magnitude and token position. Reliability must be measured under context, codebook and OOD changes rather than inferred from one successful direction.

factorization.READ: Recover the semantic/epistemic/branch-local state without requiring the runtime output symbol.
factorization.BIND_ROUTE: Bind the already-derived semantic state through an episode-local runtime codebook/route under full nuisance crossing.
factorization.WRITE: Produce/actuate the requested output representation without changing the underlying semantic branch state.
factorization.HP_UPDATE: Update or retain the Hyperposition branch set under evidence/counterevidence without unsupported collapse.
factorization.WORKSPACE_REENTRY: Transfer compressed/typed state across grid/database/Claude-workspace boundaries and measure downstream causal uptake at the strongest observable interface.

training_data_consequences: Every integrated train-eligible episode carries semantic_hyperposition from the beginning; difficult full-D update/resolve losses are staged later.
Dynamic codebook binding is trained as a relation from semantic branch/state to episode-local symbol mapping, not as class-token memorization.
The variable cognitive grid must be represented with N as a runtime parameter and no fixed module personalities.
Durable exact state is represented as database-backed identity/provenance and must not be hallucinated or simulated merely for persistence.
Claude Code handoff/return examples use typed or compact state transfer and distinguish observable causal re-entry from merely including text in a prompt.
Positive J-Space control labels are withheld until same-Qwen3.5 exact-model causal receipts exist; before then J-Space rows teach evidence boundaries, measurement protocol and hard negatives only.
Activation-control training/evaluation must include off-target behavioral regressions and authority-boundary regressions, not only target accuracy.
Composition of two vectors/subspaces is a hypothesis to test, never assumed from additive notation alone.
Successful target steering in one prompt family does not promote a global semantic direction until context/OOD tests pass.
preregistered_acceptance_dimensions_for_: semantic readout decodability on unseen vocabulary/provenance families
READ vs BIND_ROUTE vs WRITE double dissociation
S3 codebook equivariance and worst-permutation accuracy
rank/layer/magnitude/scope/token-position sweep frozen on calibration/validation only
off-target semantic and behavioral regression bounds
low-refusal target without loss of required cognition
quantized deployment revalidation at exact Q4_K_M bytes if quantization is used

new_training_family.purpose: Teach the model/evaluator the difference between evidence-qualified context-conditioned causal control and unsupported global-vector claims.

architecture_feedback.hypothesis: The most stable Xeno interface may be a small function-specific subspace family conditioned by Hyperposition state rather than one universal semantic axis.
architecture_feedback.counterhypothesis: A sufficiently well-trained single shared semantic space may generalize globally and require only a lightweight binding head.
architecture_feedback.discriminator: Preregistered comparison of global direction vs context-conditioned low-rank subspace on unseen templates/codebooks with matched intervention energy and off-target controls.

architecture_feedback.hypothesis: Separating READ, BIND_ROUTE and WRITE in the curriculum will reduce dynamic-codebook failure without damaging already-readable semantics.
architecture_feedback.counterhypothesis: Joint end-to-end SFT alone is sufficient and factorization adds no useful inductive bias.
architecture_feedback.discriminator: Matched-token pilot comparing joint-only vs staged/factorized curriculum on unseen S3 codebooks, semantic decodability and retention; holdout remains sealed.
